title_zh: NEWS IN 10 每日新聞英語｜11 月 19 日

stories.headline_en: Taiwan Uses Tiny Solar Trackers to Study Butterfly Migration
stories.headline_zh: 臺灣首創亞洲先例 以微型太陽能追蹤器研究斑蝶遷徙

sentences.en: Scientists in eastern Taiwan put tiny solar trackers on two butterflies this week.
sentences.zh: 臺灣東部的科學家本週在兩隻蝴蝶身上安裝了微型太陽能追蹤器。

sentences.en: This is the first time researchers in Asia have used this new method.
sentences.zh: 這是亞洲研究人員首次採用這項新方法進行觀察。

sentences.en: Regular people can help by turning on Bluetooth on their smartphones while hiking.
sentences.zh: 一般民眾在健行時只要開啟手機藍牙，就能協助這項研究。

sentences.en: The collected data will help experts protect butterfly flight paths during winter.
sentences.zh: 蒐集到的資料將幫助專家在冬季期間保護蝴蝶的遷徙路徑。

stories.headline_en: Cambridge Dictionary Names Human as 2026 Word of the Year
stories.headline_zh: AI 浪潮引發反思 劍橋辭典選定 human 為 2026 年度代表字

sentences.en: Cambridge Dictionary chose human as its official Word of the Year for 2026.
sentences.zh: 劍橋辭典將 human（人類）選為 2026 年的官方年度代表字。

sentences.en: The dictionary editors said rapid AI growth makes people think about human values.
sentences.zh: 辭典編輯表示，人工智慧的快速發展讓人們重新思考人類的價值。

sentences.en: Many writers and artists want clear rules to separate real work from machine copies.
sentences.zh: 許多作家與藝術家希望訂定明確規範，區分人類創作與機器複製品。

sentences.en: Experts remind young students that people should still guide how technology shapes tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 專家提醒年輕學子，未來科技如何發展仍應由人類主導。

stories.headline_en: Taiwanese Cartoon Character Capoo Stars in Seoul Tourism Campaign
stories.headline_zh: 臺灣人氣角色貓貓蟲咖波跨海代言首爾觀光宣傳

sentences.en: Seoul's tourism office teamed up with a popular cartoon character from Taiwan.
sentences.zh: 首爾觀光公社與來自臺灣的人氣卡通角色貓貓蟲咖波展開合作。

sentences.en: The cute blue character, named Capoo, has over seven million followers online.
sentences.zh: 這隻名為咖波的可愛藍色角色在網路上擁有超過七百萬名追蹤者。

sentences.en: In three new videos, Capoo wears traditional Korean clothes and visits famous palaces.
sentences.zh: 在三支新影片中，咖波穿上韓國傳統服飾並造訪著名的宮殿景點。

sentences.en: City officials hope this fun project will inspire more Taiwanese tourists to visit.
sentences.zh: 市府官員希望這項有趣的企劃能吸引更多臺灣旅客前來造訪。
